[h3] [b] 101 DOGS HIDDEN IN BERLIN [/b] [/h3]

101 Dogs Hidden in Berlin is one of the better HOG titles, created by the same developer as the 101 Cats series. The artwork looks alright and visually quite dense—elements are packed closely together, which makes spotting the hidden dogs more challenging. Thankfully, the zoom system helps balance this difficulty and becomes an essential tool during gameplay. On the downside, the music can be quite annoying. It starts off extremely loud when launching the game, which may catch players off guard. Another notable drawback is the lack of a hint system. While this choice may extend playtime, it rather leads to frustration, especially when some dogs are exceptionally well hidden and take a long time to find. Overall, the game meets expectations for the genre. It doesn’t offer deeper gameplay mechanics beyond finding all 101 dogs, but it delivers a solid and enjoyable HOG experience.

PS In case you are still missing some dogs, just take a look at my guide. :)

GL & HF :)
